title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: In Ethiopia in 2025, ICSP strengthened humanitarian response through timely mobilisation during drought‑related shocks and disease alerts, supported by coordinated risk monitoring and community‑level surveillance. Multi‑hazard contingency planning in Borena guided protective actions for over 14,000 people, while joint Mpox and Marburg preparedness with the Regional Health Bureau, PHEM units and disaster‑prevention authorities improved readiness across high‑risk zones. These partnerships enabled earlier detection of public‑health threats and more predictable, system‑aligned responses compared with earlier ICSP years, reinforcing the shift toward locally led, anticipatory humanitarian action.. Context (security and market functionality & accessibility) specific cash programming - in response to climate induced emergencies - to facilitate adaptation of livelihoods options and to promte food security.
